title: 6 Truths About Who You Are in God
paragraphs: 6 Truths About Who You Are in God
You don’t even know who you are.

And that confusion?
It’s costing you your calling.

You keep introducing yourself by your past.
God introduces you by your redemption.
Let me remind you—not hype, not feelings, but truth rooted in Scripture.

1. You are chosen.
Not random. Not accidental.
“Before I formed you… I knew you.” (Jeremiah 1:5)
God didn’t pick you last—He picked you on purpose.

2. You are forgiven.
Yes, that sin.
Yes, the one you replay at 2AM.
“In Him we have redemption through His blood.” (Ephesians 1:7)
The cross didn’t miss a spot.

3. You are a new creation.
Not improved. Not repaired.
New.
“Anyone in Christ is a new creation.” (2 Corinthians 5:17)
Stop wearing graves like they’re clothes.

4. You are God’s child.
Not just a believer—family.
“To all who received Him… He gave the right to become children of God.” (John 1:12)
You don’t beg for love—you belong to it.

5. You are empowered.
Not weak. Not helpless.
“The same Spirit… lives in you.” (Romans 8:11)
You’re carrying resurrection power in ordinary skin.

6. You are sent.
This is where most people shrink back.
But Jesus said, “As the Father has sent Me, I am sending you.” (John 20:21)
You’re not just saved—you’re commissioned.
You can know all of this—and still live like a slave.

Because identity isn’t just learned.
It’s received.
And that happens at the feet of Jesus.

So today—drop the false names.
Failure. Addict. Not enough. Too late.

That’s not your voice.
That’s not your Father.
Jesus rewrote your identity in His blood.
And He’s not taking it back.
